summary: Goodyer has eight testimonials, a sold property grid and Sotheby's listings. The page has no lead form, and typos and a broken phone link cost enquiries from sellers.

findings.problem: No lead capture form or chat appears. Visitors must click Request an Appraisal and leave the page to make contact.
findings.cost: A seller who is ready to ask about an appraisal has to do extra work, and many will call the next agent.
findings.fix: A short appraisal form on the page with a confirmation message.

findings.problem: The phone link is malformed (tel with backslashes) and may not dial. The footer social icons are labelled l and i instead of names.
findings.cost: A phone link that fails loses the calls that matter most to an agency.
findings.fix: A tested tap to call link and clearly labelled social links.

findings.problem: The page says it is dedicated exclusively to property management, yet it also promotes luxury sales and Sotheby's listings.
findings.cost: A mixed message confuses sellers about whether you can sell their home.
findings.fix: One clear positioning for sales and for management.

findings.problem: Typos include It it wise to choose experience, the right the right buyers, results.. and 110% . Stray text such as Menu and arrow symbols shows, and many sold listings only say Contact agent.
findings.cost: Typos in a premium agent's copy and hidden sale prices weaken the track record you want to show.
findings.fix: A proofread build with sold prices shown where possible.

redesign: A seller first homepage with an appraisal form, working phone links and a clear message.
Your eight testimonials and sold results beside every enquiry button.
